description: Build and release the application again without uploading it. By default that is the version last sent, with the current environment variables: this is how a changed variable or a new AI key reaches the running app. For an application built from GitHub, `latest` deploys the newest commit on its default branch instead. Returns a taskId to poll with `deployment_status`.

latest.description: GitHub applications only: deploy the branch's newest commit.

name: redeploy
title: Deploy again without sending the code
